summary.en: Help a desperate soul find a new beginning.
summary.zh: 帮助一个绝望的人寻找新的开始。

briefing.en: Deliver the mysterious old man, the kid, and their robot to Volturn in the Askonia system. Avoid patrols; they may be wanted by the authorities.
briefing.zh: 把神秘老人，小伙子，以及他们的机器人送到位于 Askonia 星系的 Volturn 行星上。避开巡逻队，你的乘客可能已被通缉。
前往位于 Askonia 星系内的 Volturn

texts.en:
You receive a comms transmission from an obviously illicit orbital repeater which provides directions to a dropoff point for the old man, the kid, and their robot. And the promise of anonymous payment.

As they walk down the shuttle's ramp, the kid exclaims, "Wow, a planet made entirely of water!"
texts.zh:
你从一个明显非法的轨道中继器里收到了前往老人、孩子和机器人下船地点的路线，以及先前许诺好的报酬。

当他们走下穿梭机的斜坡时，那孩子惊呼道："哇，一个完全由水构成的星球！"

texts.en:
You receive a comms transmission from an obviously illicit orbital repeater which provides directions to a dropoff point for the kid, and their robot. And the promise of payment.

The kid walks sullenly down the shuttle's ramp, his loyal robot trundling behind. As he steps onto the rolling deckplates of Volturn, he looks back.

"Take care of yourself, I guess," he says. "That's what you're best at, isn't it."
texts.zh:
你从一个明显非法的轨道中继器里收到了前往小伙子和机器人下船地点的路线，以及先前许诺好的报酬。

小伙子无精打采地走下了穿梭机的阶梯，他忠心的机器人跟在后面。当他踏上了 Volturn 的海上平台后，他转过身来。

"多多保重你自己吧。" 他说到。"你最擅长这个了，不是吗？"

texts.en: You're unable to safely deliver your passengers to Volturn right now.
texts.zh: 你目前无法将你的乘客安全地送达 Volturn 。

options.en: It's just a moon, kid. With a rocky core.
options.zh: 就是个卫星，孩子。内核是岩石。

options.en: We all do what we gotta do to survive, kid.
options.zh: 孩子，为了活命，我们都得做该做的事。

texts.en: The kid manages not to look disappointed at this revelation.
texts.zh: 那孩子努力不让自己对这番真相流露出失望。

texts.en: The old man smiles and simply says, "Thank you, my friend," then turns up the hood of his robe and leads the strange party into the underworld of Volturn.
texts.zh: 老人笑了笑，简单地说到。"谢谢你，我的朋友。" 随后带上了他长袍的兜帽，带着他奇怪的一行人深入了 Volturn 的地下世界。

texts.en: He looks like he's going to take the bait, but the robot bleeps at him, defusing his anger.
texts.zh: 看上去他几乎要上钩了，但是机器人对着他哔哔了几声，他冷静了下来。

texts.en:
The kids gives you a look, a mix of sadness and a checked rage that you can tell will risk boiling over for a long time to come.

He turns to his robot. "Com'on, let's go," he says.
texts.zh:
孩子们露出混合着悲伤与压抑愤怒的表情，你看得出来，这种情绪在很长一段时间内都将面临沸腾失控的风险。

他转向自己的机器人。"来吧，走了。" 他说道。

texts.en: You have a meeting scheduled with a Mammonite to talk with a third party who might know something about Jethro Bornanew, but it is not yet the agreed upon time.
texts.zh: 你有一个日程安排，准备同一个玛门之仆一起，和某位可能了解 Jethro Bornanew 的人会面。但现在还没到约定的时间。

texts.en:
The old man looks like a hermit who's been living out in the wastes for countless cycles. His robes are dusty, his skin creased and tanned.

He smiles mysteriously as you approach, and you can see he is accompanied by a mop-haired kid, a youth of not yet 20 cycles.

"I have a feeling that you're not the captain we're looking for," he says amiably. "Your $shipOrFleet is far too large. We seek simple transport, not a warfleet."

With that, he puts his hands together and gives a nod, almost a bow.
texts.zh:
老人看上去像是一个在荒郊野岭居住了无数星历年的隐士。他的袍子上满是灰尘，皮肤则被晒得又黑又皱。

在你向他走去时老人脸上露出了神秘的微笑。这时你也注意到有个看上去不到二十岁的毛头小伙陪伴在他身边。

"我觉得你不是我们要找的舰长。" 他和蔼地婉拒道，"你的$shipOrFleet规模太大了，我们只想找个普通的运输船队，不想找个战舰舰队。"

说完话，他双手相握着向你点头致意，感觉像是鞠了一躬一样。

texts.en:
The old man looks like a hermit who's been living out in the wastes for countless cycles. His robes are dusty, his skin creased and tanned.

He smiles mysteriously as you approach, and speaks both to you and the mop-haired kid, more a youth of not yet 20 cycles.

"I have a good feeling about this one."
texts.zh:
老人看上去像是一个在荒郊野岭居住了无数星历年的隐士。他的袍子上满是灰尘，他的皮肤晒得又黑又皱。

在你向他走去的同时，老人给了你个神秘的笑容，然后同时向你以及一个头发杂乱，看上去不到二十岁的小伙子说话。

"这个人我感觉不错。"

options.en: Let me guess- you need transport, no need to involve the authorities.
options.zh: 我猜猜 —— 你需要运输，而且不需要跟官方打交道。

options.en: I'd be careful about trusting your feelings around here, old man.
options.zh: 老头，在这种地方我可不敢轻信我的感觉。

options.en: What's with the robot, got some kind of AI in there?
options.zh: 这机器人又是怎么回事，里面有什么 AI 吗？

options.en: If you're some kind of terrorist, I don't want to know.
options.zh: 如果你真是什么恐怖分子，那别和我扯上关系。

options.en: If you're some kind of terrorist, I want to know.
options.zh: 如果你真是什么恐怖分子，让我开开眼。

options.en: If you're some kind of terrorist, I want to charge more.
options.zh: 如果你真是什么恐怖分子，那得加钱。

options.en: It's probably best that I not ask.
The job sounds too hot for me. Find another captain.
options.zh: 这份工作对我来说是个烫手山芋。找其他舰长吧。

options.en: Not worth my time. Find someone else.
options.zh: 这不值得我花时间。找其他人吧。

texts.en:
You make arrangements for the old man, the youth, and their robot to be shuttled to your $shipOrFleet.

They don't seem especially dangerous. Surely no one in the Hegemony or Sindrian Diktat is putting much effort into tracking their movements.
texts.zh:
你做好将老人，小伙子，以及他们的机器人送到你的$shipOrFleet上的安排.

他们看上去不算多么危险。霸主 和 辛达强权 想来也不会在追踪这种人上浪费多少精力。

texts.en: "You are quite correct, captain," the old man says. "You shall be paid 10,000 credits upon arrival in Volturn, in the Askonia system. It is as you say: we should like to avoid any patrols or inspections."
texts.zh: "你说得对，舰长。" 老人说，"抵达 Askonia 星系的 Volturn 后，你将获得 10,000 星币的报酬。正如你所说：我们应该避开任何巡逻队或检查。"

options.en: Why do the authorities want you so badly?
options.zh: 为什么当局会那么想抓到你们？

texts.en:
The youth starts to speak, "Because he's a- " and the old man lifts a finger in warning, shutting the kid up.

"Just some old history that most people have forgotten by now. It is best that you not ask, I think."
texts.zh:
年轻人开始说话，"因为那是 ——" 老人举起一根手指警告，让孩子停止讲话。

"只是一些大多数人已经忘记的旧历史。我认为你最好不要问。"

texts.en:
"They led you to me, did they not?" he says, as if it means anything.

The kid gets a look of awe, eating this line up like ancient wisdom.
texts.zh:
"把你带到我面前的不正是你的感觉吗？" 老人说到，好像这话有什么意义似的。

那小伙子则满脸崇拜，完全把这句话当成了什么古人的大智慧。

texts.en: The old man says nothing, the hint of a smile on his lips. The kid looks back and forth between you and the old man, waiting to see what will happen next.
texts.zh: 老人一言不发，只是嘴角挂着一丝若有若无的笑意。孩子在你和老人之间来回看了看，等待接下来会发生什么。

texts.en: "You don't need to worry about our little friend here," the old man says.
texts.zh: "你不用担心我们这位小伙伴。" 老人说道。

options.en: I don't need to worry about it.
Actually, I need to know if that thing is safe.
options.zh: 可是，我确实需要知道那玩意是否安全。

texts.en: The old man nods, satisfied.
texts.zh: 老人满意地点点头。

texts.en:
The kid finds his tongue. "Of course it's safe! We bought it from some scavengers and then I took it apart and put it back together myself."

It sounds like he's been holding back an outburst this whole time.

"I can fix anything!" he adds.
texts.zh:
那小伙子终于说得出话来了。"它当然安全！这是我们从一些拾荒者处买来的，我亲自把它拆解又重新组装了一遍。"

听得出来他憋话憋坏了。

"我什么都能修好！" 他补充道。

options.en: Sure. If I need some farm equipment repaired I'll let you know.
options.zh: 成。要是我有啥农具需要修理我会来找你的。

options.en: I could use a junior engineer in my fleet.
options.zh: 我的舰队可以再招个下级工程师。

options.en: So what's this about, old man?
options.zh: 所以，老头，这是怎么回事？

texts.en:
This sets the kid off.

"I'm not just some dune-farmer," the youth says, raising his voice, "I'm a great pilot just like-" the old man reaches out and touches him on the shoulder. The kid takes the hint.

"What my young friend means to say is that we have another task in mind."
texts.zh:
这把小伙子惹急了。

"我可不是什么荒地农夫。" 年轻人提高了声音说到，"我是个优秀的驾驶员，就像 —— " 老人伸出手拍了拍他的肩膀，年轻人反应了过来。

"我年轻的伙伴想说的是我们另有需要。"

texts.en:
The youth is taken aback by this respect granted to him by a space captain. He looks like he's actually thinking about it. "I can't, I mean thank you, but I'm a great pilot just like-" the old man reaches out, holding him back.

"What my young friend means to say is that his destiny lies elsewhere."
texts.zh:
年轻人明显被一位星舰舰长给与他的敬意吓到了。看上去他真的在考虑你的提议。"我做不到，感谢您，但我是个优秀的驾驶员，就像 —— " 老人忽然伸手让他打住。

"我年轻的伙伴的意思是他的命运另在他处。"

texts.en: "A simple run to Volturn. You'll be paid and then you can forget all about us," the old man says, his mysterious smile returning.
texts.zh: "就是简简单单地往 Volturn 跑一趟。你会拿到钱，然后就可以忘了我们。" 老人说到，神秘的笑容又回到了他脸上。

texts.en: The old man makes a show of exchanging a glance with the kid, who looks worried. "I don't think we look like terrorists, do you?"
texts.zh: 老人与孩子交换了个眼神，而孩子看起来很担忧。"我不觉得我们看起来像恐怖分子，你觉得呢？"

texts.en:
The old man nods like he expected this. The kid looks offended, "We could buy an old ship for that much! I bet I could get it working in no time, then we just-" the old man raises a hand to quiet him.

"I can offer you 17,000 credits upon arrival," he says calmly, "and no more."

The kid crosses his arms and sulks.
texts.zh:
老人点点头，仿佛他预料到了这一点。孩子看起来很生气，"这么多星币，够我们买一艘旧船了！我打赌我很快就能让它飞起来，然后我们就 ——" 老人举手让他安静。

"抵达后我可以支付给你 17,000 星币。" 他平静地说，"不能再多了。"

孩子交叉双臂，生着闷气。

texts.en: The old man's smile returns, like he expected you to say this.
texts.zh: 老人的笑容又回来了，就像他预料到你会这么说一样。

texts.en:
The anger and disappointment on the kid's face is palpable. The old man puts a hand on his shoulder, with just a small motion diverting the rush of youthful emotion.

As you step away, you overhear the old man speaking softly, "There is another..."
texts.zh:
小伙子脸上的愤怒和失落再清晰不过了。老人把手放在他肩膀上，这一简单的动作便止住了气血上涌的年轻人。

你离开时，你听到老人轻声说，"还有一个..."

texts.en:
"Captain," the Sindrian Diktat officer says in a level tone, "We have reason to believe that you carry a terrorist known to the Sindrian Security Directorate."

$HeOrShe barely lifts a finger, and a supplementary data package is transmitted to you. Your comms officer attaches the contents to a secondary display: it's the old man from Asharu. Much younger in this looping holo, wearing the military uniform of some minor polity instead of robes.

"It would expedite my investigation if this individual found his way to my flagship." $HeOrShe smiles the coldest, smallest smile in the Sector.
texts.zh:
"舰长，" 辛达强权 的军官沉稳地说道，"我们有理由怀疑你搭载了一位辛达安全部所认定的恐怖分子。"

$HeOrShe轻抬了下手指，你便收到了一个带有补充信息的数据包。你的通讯军官将内容放到了你的副显示屏上：这是 Asharu 上那个老人。他在这个全息回放里看上去年轻得多，身上穿着某个小势力的军服，而非长袍。

"我想，要是这位先生能来我旗舰上坐一坐，定能大大加快调查的进展。" $HeOrShe给了你一个你在星域中见过最冷，最微小的笑容。"

options.en: I'll need a moment to review my passenger manifest. (stall)
options.zh: 我需要时间检查下我的乘客列表。 (拖延时间)

options.en: I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act.
options.zh: 我就是搭载了几个沙漠农夫，这是做慈善。

options.en: You have no right to kidnap my passengers.

texts.en: The Diktat officer gives the barest nod. Your comms officer takes this as a cue to freeze the transmission.
texts.zh: 辛达强权的军官微不可见地点了下头。你的通讯军官抓住这个机会暂停了通讯。

texts.en: In a briefing room, the old man watches the holo of his younger self with a wistful smile. The kid is there, looking terrified. Their robot beeps and performs some kind of idling cycle.
texts.zh: 在简报室，老人望着他年轻时的全息投影，嘴边挂着一个怀念的微笑。小伙子也在，他看上去害怕极了。他们的机器人则在哔哔地进行着某种待机循环。

texts.en:
"Now there's a man I have not seen in a long, long time," he says quietly. "By now, even I was starting to think he might be dead."

He looks to you now, a glimmer of that younger self appearing in his face. "Give me over to them, captain. The boy must go to Volturn without me. He will be safe if they have me."

The kid is aghast. "No!" he shouts, "They'll kill you!"
texts.zh:
"我可很久，很久没有见到过这个人了。" 他轻声说到，"到这时候，连我都以为他已经死了。"

他看向你，脸上能看出些许当年的样子。"把我交给他们，舰长。这个少年必须独自前往 Volturn。只要辛达有了我，他就安全了。"

小伙子惊呆了。"不！" 他叫道，"他们会杀了你！"

options.en: I'm not handing anyone to the Diktat.
options.zh: 我不会把任何人交给强权。

options.en: No, this ends here. I'm handing you all over.
options.zh: 不，到此为止了，我会把你们都交出去。

texts.en:
The old man looks more tired than surprised.

The kid shouts, "Great! You can fight 'em off with your $shipOrFleet! I can help at the gunnery station, I'm a great shot. I promise I'll be careful and-"

You and the old man exchange a look. "Come, young one," the old man says, taking the youth by the shoulder. "We must let the good captain get to work."
texts.zh:
老人看上去与其说是惊讶，更多是疲惫。

小伙子叫道。"好！你的$shipOrFleet可以把他们都打跑！我可以帮忙操作炮台，我打的可准了。我保证我会小心而且 —— "

你跟老人交换了个眼神。"来吧，年轻人。" 老人拉住小伙子的肩膀说到。"我们得让舰长开始工作了。"

texts.en:
The Diktat officer looks less patient now, the polite smile barely a memory.

"Captain," $heOrShe says in full knowledge of your lies, and knowing you know $heOrShe knows, "I trust you've thoroughly reviewed your passenger manifest."
texts.zh:
辛达强权士官看上去没什么耐心了，之前的礼貌微笑早已不见。

"舰长。" $heOrShe说到，口气明显已知道你在撒谎，而且知道你对此自己心里也有数。"我相信你已仔细检查过了你的乘客名单。"

options.en: I have someone of interest to transfer to your flagship, officer.
options.zh: 长官，我有个你会感兴趣的人，正准备送到您的旗舰上。

options.en: I have some persons of interest to transfer to your flagship, officer.
options.zh: 长官，我有些你会感兴趣的人员，正准备送到您的旗舰上。

options.en: I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act.
options.zh: 我就是搭载了几个沙漠农夫，这是做慈善。

options.en: You have no right to kidnap my passengers.

texts.en:
The old man goes calmly to the shuttle for transfer.

"Your service to the Supreme Executor will be noted in the official records," the Diktat $personRank says as if $heOrShe is reading a script for $hisOrHer bridge crew. "Your loyalty to the Great Movement is commended, and the reward for turning in a known terrorist will now be transferred to your accounts."

$PersonRank $personLastName performs a bizarre salute and shouts something about "final victory"; your comms officer manages to extract you from the comms-link without further exchange.
texts.zh:
老人安静地走向了穿梭机等待交接。

"你为最高元首做出的贡献会在官方记录里留下一笔。" 辛达强权 $personRank 以给属下念台词的口吻说到。"你对伟大运动的忠心值得赞许，而交出著名恐怖分子的奖赏会稍后转到你手上。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 给了你个奇怪的敬礼，然后嚷嚷了几句关于 "最终的胜利" 什么的；你的通讯军官总算找到机会将你从对话中解放出来。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
You have the old man and the kid transferred to the Sindrian Diktat flagship. They even want the robot "for evidence", so you have that old piece of junk sent as well.

"Your service to the Supreme Executor will be noted in the official records," $personRank $personLastName says like $heOrShe is reading a script for $hisOrHer bridge crew. "Your loyalty to the Great Movement is commended, and your reward for turning in a known terrorist and his accomplice will now be transferred."

$HeOrShe performs a bizarre salute and shouts something about "final victory"; your comms officer manages to extract you from the comm-link without further engagement.
texts.zh:
你把老人和小伙子送上了 辛达强权 旗舰。他们甚至为了 "收集证据"，把那个机器人也要了过去。

"你为最高元首做出的贡献会在官方记录里留下一笔。" $personRank $personLastName 以给属下念台词的口吻说到。"你对伟大运动的忠心值得赞许，而交出著名恐怖分子和他同伙的奖赏会稍后转到你手上。"

$HeOrShe 给了你个奇怪的敬礼，然后嚷嚷了几句关于 "最终的胜利" 什么的；你的通讯军官总算找到机会将你从对话中解放出来。

texts.en:
And that's the end of it. You start to wonder how things might have gone differently if you'd carried out the job and snuck what was clearly some kind of former military officer and his protege into contact with a faction of the Askonian underground...

You call to navigation to lay in a new course.
texts.zh:
事情就这么了结了。你不由得想了下如果你把那个前军官和他的小徒弟按约定送到了某个 Askonia 地下组织的手上后事情会怎样发展...

你叫领航官指定一道新航线。

texts.en:
"Transporting sand farmers," the Diktat officer repeats, "For charity."

More than a hint of disbelief slips out at the final word.
texts.zh:
"运输沙漠农夫，" 辛达强权士官重复道。"做慈善。"

他最后一个字中露出了不止一星半点的怀疑。

texts.en:
Then anger cracks across $hisOrHer face, "That is the most preposterous lie I've ever-"

A ping from the other bridge comes across the comms, interrupting the beginning of $hisOrHer tirade. The Diktat officer gives you a killing look then exchanges quiet words with some underlings; your comms officer gives you a tentative nod.
texts.zh:
$hisOrHer终于愤怒地爆发了。"这是我听过最扯淡的 ——"

一声哔声从对面舰桥的通讯台传来，打断了$hisOrHer正要开始的长篇大论。辛达强权的军官死死瞪了你一眼，掉头跟几个手下低声交谈了几句；你的通讯军官试探性地点了点头。

texts.en:
Your quick-thinking bridge crew has provided a fake manifest on your behalf, of course.

Of course they would have a plausible but misleading pre-generated crew and passenger manifest ready for just such a situation. If you offered it with enough confidence - and very little delay - it might just work.

You wait with saintly patience as the Diktat officer has an underling run the fake manifest through the latest Diktat search and verification algorithms.
texts.zh:
你反应机敏的舰桥组员早就理所当然地替你提交了一份伪造的载员名册。

正是为了应付这种情况，他们理所当然地预先备好了一份看似合理却极具误导性的载员名册。只要你不带半点犹豫、自信满满地把它递交上去，搞不好真能糊弄过去。

你心怀圣人般的沉稳耐心等待，看着这位辛达强权军官吩咐手下用强权最新的检索与核验算法去过一遍那份伪造的舱单。

texts.en:
You hear an angry call of "Run it again!" that perhaps was not intended to get picked up by comms. It takes a few more minutes.

"Very well," the Diktat officer says with what sounds like clenched teeth, "Your manifest has been verified. Technically."

With a sharp motion, $heOrShe signals to $hisOrHer comms to cut the link.
texts.zh:
透过通讯台，你听到愤怒的声音要求 "再查一遍！"，或许对方没注意你能听到。之后又过了几分钟。

"好吧。" 辛达强权士官咬牙说到。"你的乘员名单至少在技术意义上确认属实。"

$heOrShe随即挥手让$hisOrHer的通讯员切断链接。

texts.en:
The smile disappears, like it barely existed.

"I see."

The Diktat officer turns away, motioning to $hisOrHer bridge crew, "In the name of the Supreme Executor I order you to power down your systems and prepare to be boarded," then looks back over $hisOrHer shoulder, and adds "Our search will be... thorough."
texts.zh:
对方的笑容消失了，好像从没存在过一般。

"我明白了。"

辛达强权的士官转过头去，对$hisOrHer的舰桥组员比了个手势，"以最高元首的名义，我令你关闭护盾，准备被登舰。" $hisOrHer往后望了下，补充道："我们会...仔细检查。"

options.en: No, that isn't going to happen.
I'm transporting a couple sand farmers. It's a charitable act.
options.zh: 我就是搭载了几个沙漠农夫，这是做慈善。

texts.en: "Then," $heOrShe seems to find pleasure in $hisOrHer words for the first time, "You are resisting a lawful search performed under the authority of the Supreme Executor. A hostile act of terrorism against our dear Sindrian Diktat."
texts.zh: "那么，" $heOrShe似乎终于从$hisOrHer自己的话语中感受到了愉悦。"那你就是在抵抗最高元首权威下合法的检查。这乃针对我们敬爱的 辛达强权 的恐怖主义行为。"

texts.en:
"We shall take no prisoners!" the Diktat officer shouts, "Those who harbor terrorists are themselves terrorists, and will be treated as-"

The link cuts out. Your comms officer gives you an apologetic look.
texts.zh:
"我们将不留俘虏！" 辛达强权士官吼道。"包庇恐怖分子者皆是恐怖分子，我们会将其 ——"

通讯链接被切断了，你的通讯军官面带着些许歉意看了你一眼。

texts.en:
The Diktat troopers sent to search your fleet seem more interested in bullying your crew and breaking delicate machinery than performing a legitimate search.

Your passengers are easily hidden, but you can tell by the expression on your engineering chief's face that serious damage has been done.
texts.zh:
登舰检查的辛达强权士兵与其说是进行合法检查，更像是来破坏精密设备和欺压你的船员的。

把你的乘客藏好不难，但是你的总工程师的表情清楚地告诉你损害不轻。

texts.en: "All glory to the Lion of Sindria," $personRank $personLastName with a final smirk before severing the comm-link.
texts.zh: "荣耀归于辛达瑞亚之狮。" $personRank $personLastName 脸上带着讥笑中断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
"What!?" the kid shouts, "You can't do that. You have to fight! You have a $shipOrFleet! You're just going to let those Diktat goons order you around?" He lunges at you, and is bodily intercepted by the arm of one of your guards. After a yelp and a moment of struggle, the kid folds to an electrostun rod.

The old man does not give the commotion even a glance. Instead, his eyes are steady on yours. Looking deeply for something.

"He has so much to learn, $playerName." He looks thoughtful, "Fate may surprise us yet."
texts.zh:
"什么？！" 小伙子吼道，"你不能这样做，你得反击！你有$shipOrFleet！难道就让这些辛达强权的混混们随便差遣你吗？" 他向你扑来，被你的一个卫兵伸手拦住。他短暂的挣扎之后挨了一电击棍，呻吟一声安静下来了。

老人对刚刚的骚动视而不见。他的眼睛直直地盯着你的眼睛，试图探寻你深处的什么东西。

"他要学的还有很多，$playerName。" 他看上去在沉思。"命运或许还能给我们一个惊喜。"

"What!?" the kid shouts, "You can't do that! You're just-" he lunges at you, and is bodily intercepted by the arm of one of your guards. After a yelp and a moment of struggle, the kid folds to an electrostun rod.

The old man does not give the commotion even a glance. Instead, his eyes are steady on yours. Looking deeply for something.

"So this is how you choose, $playerName." He looks thoughtful, "Fate may surprise us yet."

"所以这便是你的选择，$playerName。" 他似乎陷入沉思。"命运或许还能给我们一个惊喜。"

texts.en: Unfortunately the kid speaks up. "Wow, is that you? I knew it! You were part of-" The old man holds up a hand to stop the outburst. He closes his eyes.
texts.zh: 不幸的是，小伙子开口了，"哇，那是你吗？我就知道！你是——" 老人抬手制止了这位十分激动的小伙子。他闭上了眼睛。

texts.en: The Diktat officer gives the barest nod. Your comms officer takes this as a cue to freeze the transmission.
texts.zh: 辛达强权的军官微不可见地点了下头。你的通讯军官抓住这个机会暂停了通讯。

texts.en: In a briefing room, the old man watches the holo of his younger self with a wistful smile. The kid is there, looking terrified. Their robot beeps and performs some kind of idling cycle.
texts.zh: 在简报室，老人望着他年轻时的全息投影，嘴边挂着一个怀念的微笑。小伙子也在，他看上去害怕极了。他们的机器人则在哔哔地进行着某种待机循环。

texts.en: Unfortunately the kid speaks up. "Wow, is that you? I knew it! You were part of-" The old man holds up a hand to stop the outburst. He closes his eyes.
texts.zh: 不幸的是，小伙子开口了，"哇，那是你吗？我就知道！你是——" 老人抬手制止了这位十分激动的小伙子。他闭上了眼睛。

texts.en:
"Now there's a man I have not seen in a long, long time," he says quietly. "By now, even I was starting to think he might be dead."

He looks to you now, a glimmer of that younger self appearing in his face. "Give me over to them, captain. The boy must go to Volturn without me. He will be safe if they have me."

The kid is aghast. "No!" he shouts, "They'll kill you!"

"Your service to the Supreme Executor will be noted in the official records," the Diktat $personRank says as if $heOrShe is reading a script for $hisOrHer bridge crew. "Your loyalty to the Great Movement is commended, and the reward for turning in a known terrorist will now be transferred to your accounts."

$PersonRank $personLastName performs a bizarre salute and shouts something about "final victory"; your comms officer manages to extract you from the comms-link without further exchange.
texts.zh:
老人安静地走向了穿梭机等待交接。

"你为最高元首做出的贡献会在官方记录里留下一笔。" 辛达强权 $personRank 以给属下念台词的口吻说到。"你对伟大运动的忠心值得赞许，而交出著名恐怖分子的奖赏会稍后转到你手上。"

$PersonRank $personLastName 给了你个奇怪的敬礼，然后嚷嚷了几句关于 "最终的胜利" 什么的；你的通讯军官总算找到机会将你从对话中解放出来。

texts.en:
You have the old man and the kid transferred to the Sindrian Diktat flagship. They even want the robot "for evidence", so you have that old piece of junk sent as well.

"Your service to the Supreme Executor will be noted in the official records," $personRank $personLastName says like $heOrShe is reading a script for $hisOrHer bridge crew. "Your loyalty to the Great Movement is commended, and your reward for turning in a known terrorist and his accomplice will now be transferred."

$HeOrShe performs a bizarre salute and shouts something about "final victory"; your comms officer manages to extract you from the comm-link without further engagement.
texts.zh:
你把老人和小伙子送上了 辛达强权 旗舰。他们甚至为了 "收集证据"，把那个机器人也要了过去。

"你为最高元首做出的贡献会在官方记录里留下一笔。" $personRank $personLastName 以给属下念台词的口吻说到。"你对伟大运动的忠心值得赞许，而交出著名恐怖分子和他同伙的奖赏会稍后转到你手上。"

$HeOrShe 给了你个奇怪的敬礼，然后嚷嚷了几句关于 "最终的胜利" 什么的；你的通讯军官总算找到机会将你从对话中解放出来。

texts.en:
"We shall take no prisoners!" the Diktat officer shouts, "Those who harbor terrorists are themselves terrorists, and will be treated as-"

The link cuts out. Your comms officer gives you an apologetic look.
texts.zh:
"我们将不留俘虏！" 辛达强权士官吼道。"包庇恐怖分子者皆是恐怖分子，我们会将其 ——"

通讯链接被切断了，你的通讯军官面带着些许歉意看了你一眼。

texts.en:
You hear an angry call of "Run it again!" that perhaps was not intended to get picked up by comms. It takes a few more minutes.

"Very well," the Diktat officer says with what sounds like clenched teeth, "Your manifest has been verified. Technically."

With a sharp motion, $heOrShe signals to $hisOrHer comms to cut the link.
texts.zh:
透过通讯台，你听到愤怒的声音要求 "再查一遍！"，或许对方没注意你能听到。之后又过了几分钟。

"好吧。" 辛达强权士官咬牙说到。"你的乘员名单至少在技术意义上确认属实。"

$heOrShe随即挥手让$hisOrHer的通讯员切断链接。

texts.en:
And that's the end of it. You start to wonder how things might have gone differently if you'd carried out the job and snuck what was clearly some kind of former military officer and his protege into contact with a faction of the Askonian underground...

You call to navigation to lay in a new course.
texts.zh:
事情就这么了结了。你不由得想了下如果你把那个前军官和他的小徒弟按约定送到了某个 Askonia 地下组织的手上后事情会怎样发展...

你叫领航官指定一道新航线。

options.en: I know someone on Westernesse who might help you. Cavin Pharoh.
options.zh: 我认识 Westernesse 上的一个人，他或许能帮你。Cavin Pharoh。

options.en: If you need safe transport to an independent world, I can arrange it.
options.zh: 如果你需要前往独立世界的安保运输，我可以安排。

options.en: I did transport an old man and a kid to Volturn. I think they're part of your resistance...
options.zh: 我确实运送过一位老人和一个孩子去 Volturn。我觉得他们是你的抵抗组织的一员...

options.en: I did transport a kid and his robot to Volturn, I think they wanted to join your resistance...
options.zh: 我确实运送过一个孩子和他的机器人去 Volturn，我觉得他们是想加入你的抵抗组织...

options.en: Do you need armaments? Supplies? Credits?
options.zh: 你们需要军火吗？补给？还是星币？

options.en: That's all I can think of for now.
options.zh: 目前我只能想到这些了。

options.en: Then stay here and freeze! I can't solve all your problems for you.
options.zh: 那就留在这里喝西北风去吧！我没法替你解决所有问题。

texts.en:
"I haven't heard the name."

She leans forward, "Is he an organizer? An arms dealer? A mercenary, a terrorist?"
texts.zh:
"我没听过这个名字。"

她身体前倾，"他是组织者？军火商？佣兵，还是恐怖分子？"

options.en: I think he's maybe some kind of artist?
options.zh: 我觉得他可能是某种艺术家？

options.en: I'm not sure. I just visited a slum where he was probably squatting.
options.zh: 我不确定，我刚去过一个他可能曾暂居过的贫民区。

texts.en:
"Um."

Imoinu gives you a look of re-assessment, the sort that seems to ask if the subject has all of their reactor plating installed correctly, so to speak.

"Thanks," she manages. "I uh, I'll... look him up. If I need an artist."
texts.zh:
"呃。"

Imoinu 向你投来重新审视的目光，那是一种仿佛在确认对方的反应堆护板是否安装妥当的眼神，可以这么说。

"谢了，" 她勉强说道，"我，呃，会...查查他的资料。如果哪天需要艺术家的话。"

texts.en:
"Um." Imoinu gives you a look of re-assessment, the sort that asks, 'Is this person crazy?'

"Uh. Thanks. I'll... look him up if I need somewhere to stay on Westernesse."
texts.zh:
"呃。" Imoinu 向你投来重新审视的目光，那是一种仿佛在问 '这人是不是疯了？' 的眼神。

"呃。谢了。如果我哪天需要在 Westernesse 落脚的话...我会查查他的信息。"

texts.en:
A long pause, then she speaks.

"I'll keep that in mind."
texts.zh:
沉默许久后，她说道。

"我会记在心里的。"

texts.en:
"An old man and a kid?" She looks confused, mostly at your implied expectation that she would know what you're talking about.

"I haven't heard anything about that. I couldn't say if they were important, or..."
texts.zh:
"一个老人和一个孩子？" 她看上去很困惑，主要是对你暗示她应该明白你在说什么的期待而感到不解。

"我没听说这事，也无法判断他们是否重要，或者..."

texts.en: "Look. I'm sure the local ARC cells will take them in if they have a contact."
texts.zh: "听着。如果他们有联络人，本地的 Askonia 革命者委员会分部肯定会收留他们的。"

texts.en: "A kid and a robot?" She makes a face. "I don't see how that's helpful."
texts.zh: "一个孩子和机器人？" 她做了个怪表情，"我看不出这有什么用。"

texts.en: "I mean." Realizing her dismissiveness, she attempts a more conciliatory tone. "I'm sure if this kid is dedicated to the cause, they'll figure out how to join the ARC."
texts.zh: "我是说。" 意识到自己的轻慢态度后，她试图转用更缓和的语气，"我相信如果这孩子真心投身于事业，那他总会找到加入 Askonia 革命者委员会的方法。"

texts.en:
"I thank you for your offer, captain, but I'm still arranging distribution of your previous contribution. It takes about a month to get everything where it needs to go."

She pauses, hesitant. Then explains, the frustration clear in her expression.

"The problem is if we stockpile too much materiel... it starts to 'get lost'. We work with a large number of individuals who are not... as ideologically committed to the ARC, and to the uprising, as I'd prefer."
texts.zh:
"感谢你的提议，舰长，但我仍在分发你之前的支援物资。将所有物资送达所需地点需要大约一个月的时间。"

她顿了顿，略显犹豫。随后解释道，神情明显带着沮丧。

"问题在于如果我们囤积过多物资、星币、补给...它们就会开始 '丢失'。我们合作的大量人员并非...像我们期望那样，对 Askonia 革命者委员会、对起义事业抱有坚定的意识形态认同。"

texts.en:
"I thank you for your offer, captain, but I'm still arranging distribution of your previous contribution. It'll take about two days to get everything where it needs to go."

She pauses, hesitant. Then explains, the frustration clear in her expression.

"The problem is if we stockpile too much materiel... it starts to 'get lost'. We work with a large number of individuals who are not... as ideologically committed to the ARC, and to the uprising, as I'd prefer."
texts.zh:
"多谢你的好意，舰长，可你上回捐的那批东西我还没分发完。要把一切都送到该去的地方，还得两天左右。"

她迟疑着顿了顿，这才解释起来，一脸的懊恼明明白白写在脸上。

"麻烦在于，物资一旦囤得太多... 就开始'不翼而飞'了。跟我们打交道的那么些人，对 ARC、对起义的信念，可没我希望的那么... 坚定。"

texts.en:
She perks up. "Yes!"

"We need all the help we can get! Fuel, supplies and no, not credits exactly..."

Imoinu looks at you, her eyes hard.

"If we're going to launch an uprising against the tyrant from every polity he's put under his boot, we're going to need weapons. Heavy weapons."
texts.zh:
她一下来了精神。"太好了！"

"我们缺人手缺得紧，什么支援都要！燃料、补给，还有，不，倒也不全是星币..."

Imoinu 盯着你，眼神硬了起来。

"要把那个把一个个政体都踩在脚下的暴君掀翻，我们就得有武器。重武器。"

texts.en:
"Yes!" She perks up. "We need all the help we can get! Fuel, supplies and no, not credits exactly..."

Imoinu looks at you, eyes hard.

"We're fighting against those tyrants in every polity they've stamped their boots over. We need weapons, heavy weapons. And fuel, and supplies."
texts.zh:
"太好了！\" 她一下来了精神。\"什么支援我们都缺！燃料、补给，还有，不，倒也不全是星币..."

Imoinu 盯着你，眼神硬了起来。

"那些暴君把一个个政体都踩在脚下，我们就是在跟他们打。我们要武器，重武器。还要燃料，要补给。"

texts.en:
She perks up. "Yes. Absolutely."
OR
"It would be much appreciated," she says.
texts.zh:
她眼睛一亮。"当然。绝对的。"
OR
"这真是帮了大忙了，" 她说道。

texts.en: "The fuel you've given is already bringing in more weapons and recruits. And we're running hit-and-run operations on Diktat convoys further out than ever!"
texts.zh: "你给的燃料已经换回更多武器和人手了。我们对辛达强权的运输队打起了游击，比以往伸得还远！"

texts.en: "I've managed to smuggle most of the weapons to cells on Volturn and Sindria," she grins. "When we rise, their bunkers and mechs will fall."
texts.zh: "大部分武器我都设法偷运给了 Volturn 和 Sindria 上的地下小组，" 她咧嘴一笑。"等我们起事，他们的地堡和机甲都得塌。"

texts.en: "I've managed to smuggle most of the weapons to cells on Volturn and Sindria," she grins. "The bootlickers in their bunkers and mechs are already discovering that they're not so invincible as they thought."
texts.zh: "大部分武器我都设法偷运给了 Volturn 和 Sindria 上的地下小组，" 她咧嘴一笑。"那些躲在地堡和机甲里的走狗，已经开始明白自己没那么不可战胜了。"

texts.en: "I got the supplies out - most of them - to comrades across the system." She looks quite earnest, as she speaks. "Thanks to you, they'll be ready for the uprising."
texts.zh: "补给我发出去了 —— 大部分吧 —— 送到了星系各处的同志手里。\" 她说得十分恳切。\"多亏了你，起事那天他们才备得齐。"

texts.en:
She looks at you suspiciously.

"Why? Aren't you just another bloody-handed mercenary for a choose-your-flavor imperialist?"
texts.zh:
她满腹疑心地打量着你。

"为什么？你不又是个双手沾血、随便给哪路帝国主义者都能卖命的雇佣兵？"

texts.en:
"Thank you, $playerName. We've been desperate for heavy weapons from the start - these'll allow us to hit back.

A vicious smile grows, "And hard."
texts.zh: "感谢你，$playerName。我们的重武器一直短缺，这些足够我们搞些动静。" 她露出一股阴险的笑容，"大动静。"

texts.en: She nods.
texts.zh: 她点了点头。

texts.en: She pauses for a moment, self-conscious.
texts.zh: 她顿了顿，像是有些不自在。

texts.en: She nods.
texts.zh: 她点了点头。

texts.en: She pauses for a moment, self-conscious.
texts.zh: 她顿了顿，像是有些不自在。

texts.en:
"You've been an invaluable help to the resistance," she says, "but there's not much more you can do for us on Umbra."

"If you can use any of your influence, your abilities, to advance the cause through other contacts, organizations..."

"As for me, I've got work to do. She looks grimly determined, despite her youth. "The general uprising of the United Front isn't going to launch itself!"
texts.zh:
"你帮了抵抗组织天大的忙，\" 她说道，\"不过在 Umbra，你能替我们做的已经不多了。"

"要是你能拿自己的人脉、自己的本事，通过别的门路、别的组织，把事业往前推一推..."

"至于我，还有活要干。\" 她年纪虽轻，神情却决绝。\"联合阵线的总起义，可不会自己发动起来！"

texts.en:
"You're an invaluable help to the resistance," she says, "but there's not much more you can do for us on Umbra."

"If you can use any of your influence, your abilities, to fight for the uprising through other contacts, organizations..."

"As for me, I've got work to do. She looks grimly determined, despite her youth. "This war for liberation from the tyrrany of Andradas isn't going to fight itself."
texts.zh:
"你帮了抵抗组织天大的忙，\" 她说道，\"不过在 Umbra，你能替我们做的已经不多了。"

"要是你能拿自己的人脉、自己的本事，通过别的门路、别的组织，替起义再出一把力..."

"至于我，还有活要干。\" 她年纪虽轻，神情却决绝。\"这场挣脱 Andrada 家族暴政的解放战争，可不会自己打起来。"

texts.en:
"When the time is right," she grins, "You'll be able to see the fireworks from Kazeron."

Imoinu clears her throat.

"I'd... be proud to call you my comrade, captain," she says. "Thank you."
texts.zh:
"等时机一到，\" 她咧嘴一笑，\"你在 Kazeron 都能望见那场烟火。"

Imoinu 清了清嗓子。

"我会... 很自豪能叫你一声同志，舰长，\" 她说道。\"谢谢你。"

texts.en:
"You're going to be able to see the fireworks from Kazeron," she says with a grin.

Imoinu clears her throat.

"I'd... be proud to call you my comrade, captain," she says. "Thank you."
texts.zh:
"到那时你在 Kazeron 都能望见那场烟火，" 她咧嘴笑道。

Imoinu 清了清嗓子。

"我会... 很自豪能叫你一声同志，舰长，\" 她说道。\"谢谢你。"

options.en: You're welcome. I'll be watching for those fireworks.
options.zh: 不必客气。那场烟火，我会等着看的。

She nods.

"Until then."

她点了点头。

"那就到时候见。"

texts.en:
She smiles.

"Death to Andradas!"
texts.zh:
她笑了。

"Andradas 一家都该死！"

texts.en:
"Thank you $playerName," she says.

"Fuel will allow the ARC to bring in comrades from the rest of the Core Worlds, as well as smuggle weapons and supplies."

A feral smile grows, "And raid the fleets of the tyrant Andrada!"
texts.zh:
"谢谢你，$playerName，" 她说道。

"有了燃料，ARC 就能把核心世界其他地方的同志接过来，也能偷运武器和补给。"

她脸上泛起一股野性的笑意，"还能去劫暴君 Andrada 的舰队！"

texts.en:

"Fuel will allow the ARC to bring in comrades from the rest of the Core Worlds, as well as smuggle weapons and supplies."

A feral smile grows, "And raid the fleets of the Andrada tyrants!"
texts.zh:

"有了燃料，ARC 就能把核心世界其他地方的同志接过来，也能偷运武器和补给。"

她脸上泛起一股野性的笑意，"还能去劫 Andrada 家那些暴君的舰队！"

texts.en:
"Thank you, $playerName," she says.

"I'll ensure these supplies get to ships carrying out ARC missions, and to the underground resistance fighters."
texts.zh: "感谢你，$playerName，" 她说道，"我会确保这些补给能送达执行 Askonia 革命者委员会任务的舰船。"

options.en: The truth is Reynard Hannan wants to annoy your grandmother. So here I am.
options.zh: 实话说吧，是 Reynard Hannan 想恶心你祖母，所以我就来了。

options.en: Maybe I am. But I want to destroy the Sindrian Diktat, too
options.zh: 也许是吧。不过我也想亲手毁了辛达强权。

options.en: Perhaps, but I want to destroy Dolos Macario. Personally. For vengeance.
options.zh: 也许吧，可我想毁掉的是 Dolos Macario。亲手，为了报仇。

options.en: Yes. And Orcus Rao ordered this bloody-handed merc to help you.
options.zh: 没错。而且正是 Orcus Rao 吩咐我这个双手沾血的雇佣兵来帮你的。

texts.en:
She looks appalled. And amused.

"Incredible. Our 'betters' are so petty. The lengths they'll go to sabotage within their own class!"

Imoinu shrugs while rolling her eyes.

"Well if it means you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll take it."
texts.zh:
她一脸震惊，又忍不住觉得好笑。

"真是开了眼。我们那些'上等人'竟这么小气，为了在同阶级里互相拆台，什么手段都使得出来！"

Imoinu 翻着白眼耸了耸肩。

"行吧，只要这意味着你肯给起义送军火，我就收下。"

texts.en: "Agreed." She nods, allowing a smile to slip through her well-practiced expression of revolutionary stoicism. "I'll take your weapons."
texts.zh: "成交。\" 她点点头，那副练得炉火纯青的革命者坚毅神情里，漏出了一丝笑意。\"你的武器，我收下了。"

texts.en:
"Well," she's still reserved. "I suppose it doesn't matter if the ideological basis for your motivation is unsound... weapons are weapons. And if you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll accept them."

"Just don't," an accusing finger appears, "think I'll sell out the revolution for lucre."
texts.zh:
"好吧，\" 她仍旧有所保留。\"你那些动机的思想根基站不站得住脚，我看也不打紧... 武器就是武器。只要你肯给起义送军火，我就收。"

"只是别，\" 一根手指头指了过来，\"以为我会为了几个钱把革命卖了。"

texts.en:
"Well," she's still reserved. "I suppose it doesn't matter if your motivations are a perverse sublimination of ownerist grievance psychology... weapons are weapons. And if you're willing to arm the uprising, I'll accept them."

"Just don't," an accusing finger appears, "think I'll sell out the revolution for lucre."
texts.zh:
"好吧，\" 她仍旧有所保留。\"就算你那点动机，不过是有产者怨愤心理的一番扭曲升华... 武器就是武器。只要你肯给起义送军火，我就收。"

"只是别，\" 一根手指头指了过来，\"以为我会为了几个钱把革命卖了。"

texts.en:
She looks shocked by your words at first, but shock is quickly overcome by cynical amusement.

"I see. One of the aristocratic military caste employed by one faction of ownerist warmongers is seeking advantage over another."

"If it means you're going to arm the uprising," Imoinu says with a shrug, "I'll take it."
texts.zh:
她乍一听像是吃了一惊，可那点惊愕转眼就化成了带着嘲弄的玩味。

"我明白了。说到底，是一伙有产者好战势力雇来的军事贵族，想压过另一伙罢了。"

"只要这意味着你会给起义送军火，\" Imoinu 耸了耸肩，\"我就收下。"

"Whatever." She scowls. "I didn't even ask for your help!"

Imoinu holds up a hand.

"I understand that you're trying to help, but building a revolutionary movement is more than just collecting completely random people."

"Well," she reconsiders, "It's a part of it, I guess. But I don't need you for that. Well-"

She lets out an exasperated breath.

Imoinu 抬起一只手。

"好吧，" 她重新斟酌道，"这部分也算必要吧。但我不需要你来处理这些。唉 ——"

她泄气地长叹一声。

texts.en:
"If you want to bring volunteers to the ARC and the United Front, that is helpful and I appreciate your contribution to the struggle. But you don't need to tell me about every stray you picked up on your way to Askonia."

"If you have credits, supplies, heavy weapons, or recruits... yes, we'll accept them gladly and with thanks. That's how you can help."
